falsification_criteria: If latent_mse@4 does not decrease by at least 50% after 1000 training steps with the new learning rate
If cosine@3 remains below 0.0 or continues to oscillate with amplitude > 0.5
hypotheses.mechanism: A high learning rate induces large parameter updates that overshoot optimal regions, leading to gradient explosion in latent space predictions. This manifests as diverging MSE and alternating cosine alignments as the optimizer fails to converge on stable dynamics, resulting in catastrophic error accumulation over longer horizons.
hypotheses.statement: The dominant failure is optimization_instability, evidenced by exponentially growing latent MSE and highly oscillatory cosine similarity scores across prediction horizons, likely caused by an excessively high learning rate causing gradient divergence and unstable latent space updates.
hypotheses.title: Optimization Instability Driven by Excessive Learning Rate
